description: Defines classes and templates for handling text streams with different terminators, including null, carriage return, and line feed terminators. Implements mechanisms for sending, receiving, and processing text data with termination detection.

classes.name: TerminatorCarriageReturnLineFeed
classes.description: Handles combined '\n\r' termination detection with internal state tracking.

classes.name: StreamTextType
classes.description: Template class for managing text streams with customizable terminators, including sending, receiving, and state management.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Detects if a character signifies termination based on the terminator type.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminator marker.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data from the internal queue over the connection.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming data, detects termination, and triggers callbacks.
